milestone_targeted: reaches for and grasps an object
step_by_step_instructions: Sit the child comfortably on the floor.
Place a soft ball just within arm's reach.
Encourage the child to reach out and grasp the ball.
Slowly move the ball a little farther to encourage stretching and crawling toward it.

milestone_targeted: uses two-word phrases / takes turns in simple conversation
step_by_step_instructions: Give the child a toy phone (or use your hand as a pretend phone).
Model a short call: 'Hello! How are you?'
Pause and encourage the child to respond with words.
Take turns 'calling' each other to build back-and-forth conversation.

inclusion_modifications.instruction_override: Non-verbal child: downgrade to a gesture-return activity such as 'Copying Actions' or 'Hide and Discover' (Navchetana 4.3) - the child returns gestures instead of speaking.

milestone_targeted: imitates actions and follows simple words
step_by_step_instructions: Choose a short rhyme with simple hand and body actions.
Say each line slowly (auditory) while doing the matching action (kinesthetic).
Encourage the child to copy the actions.
Repeat several times so the child anticipates each action.

inclusion_modifications.instruction_override: Hearing impairment: add bright-coloured picture cards for each action (visual). Visual impairment: emphasise voice, sound and touch - sing, clap and guide the child's hands (VAKT, Navchetana 4.3).
